purpose: Teach: 織り/格子/三輪/面影/根強い/坊さん/悔い/実体験

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、織り、絶対、家庭科で、絶対、習ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm serious — I learned about weaving in home ec class, I really did.
lines.style: Quick, emphatic insistence. Leans forward slightly. Needs her to believe him. Sharp on the stressed syllables, earnest and a little breathless — the urgency of a child convinced he has proof.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、窓、絶対、格子、絶対、伝統的でしょ?翔くん
lines.en: At Grandpa's house, you know — all those window lattices, so traditional, right Sho?
lines.style: Warm, conversational anchor. Gentle pull to memory. Not questioning him, but weaving his moment into something larger. Soft pace, like she's thinking aloud with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、三輪、絶対、自転車、絶対、もう、絶対、卒業したよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm telling you — I've already grown out of tricycles.
lines.style: Small pride underneath. Still needs reassurance but stating fact. Sits a little straighter in the voice. Quiet but firm, like he's measured this against something important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんに、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、面影、絶対、感じるわよね、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, I can see your father's face in you when I look at Grandpa.
lines.style: Soft landing on the observation. No hurry. Tender recognition — she's telling him something true and letting him hold it. Slight wonder in the tone, like she's just noticed it again.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくの好きなアニメ、本気で、絶対、根強い、絶対、人気だよ、ママ
lines.en: Mom, my favorite anime — it has this really devoted fanbase, I'm telling you.
lines.style: Bright animated energy. Quick tempo, stakes feel high to him. Wants her attention on this one thing. Small laugh underneath — he knows it matters and knows it's small, and that's part of why he cares.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 近所のお寺の、本気で、絶対、坊さん、絶対、優しい、絶対、方なのよ、翔くん
lines.en: The monk at the temple near us — he's such a kind person, Sho.
lines.style: Thoughtful, establishing something true about the world. She's not correcting him; she's adding. Conversational, like she's sharing an observation that just came to her. Warm but not performing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、もっと、絶対、お祖父ちゃんと、絶対、お話、絶対、しておけば、絶対、よかったって、絶対、悔い、絶対、残ってるよ
lines.en: Mom, I wish I'd talked to Grandpa more. I really do. I feel like I missed out.
lines.style: Quiet ache underneath. No performance. Words come carefully — he's telling her something he carries. Slow pace, trailing off at the end like he's not quite finished feeling it. Small but steady voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、実体験、絶対、翔くん、絶対、これから、絶対、ゆっくり、絶対、聞きましょうね
lines.en: Grandpa's stories — the real ones — we can listen to them slowly together from now on, okay?
lines.style: Gentle promise. Not erasing his regret but opening a door forward. Warm, present, inviting him into something shared. Slight rise at the end — she's asking him to come with her, not just telling him it's okay.
